summary: A Russian private military company, financed and directed by Yevgeny Prigozhin, that fought in Ukraine from 2014, in Syria and across the Sahel, and recruited from Russian prisons for the assault on Bakhmut. It mutinied against the Russian Ministry of Defence in June 2023 and was broken up after Prigozhin's death two months later; its African operations passed to the ministry. It is here because the rebellion of 2023 is a record in this atlas and has no other actor.
